and that he had spoken to Bill Gordon of Monmouth-Evergreen Records about a vocal because it doesn't make sense to have an Hoagy Carmichael album and not have vocals. So Bill Borden said, well where are you going to find a singer around, you know, that can do it. So Bob recommended me. And so Bill Borden came down to the River Boat and he heard me while I was there and he agreed.
